titre: Commandes de robots en Amérique du Nord
sous_titre: Nombre de robots commandés par trimestre, du premier trimestre 2025 au deuxième trimestre 2026

T1 2025.texte: companies purchased 9,064 units valued at $580.7 million in Q1 of 2025.

T2 2025.texte: In Q2 alone, companies ordered 8,571 robots worth $513 million, marking a 9% increase in units over Q2 2024.

T3 2025.texte: Third-quarter orders totaled 8,806 robots valued at $574 million, an 11.6% increase in units and a 17.2% rise in revenue.

T4 2025.texte: In the fourth quarter of 2025, companies ordered 10,325 robots valued at $579 million.

T1 2026.texte: North American companies ordered 9,055 robots valued at $543 million in the first quarter of 2026

T2 2026.texte: North American companies ordered 8,940 robots valued at $622 million in Q2
